description: This file contains utility functions that generate sample ingredient tasks for demo and testing purposes in a cooking/to-do list application. It provides two functions, getInitialIngredients and getRequestedSampleIngredients, which return arrays of task objects created via an imported createTask function.

methods.name: getInitialIngredients
methods.description: Returns an array of pre-populated ingredient tasks for demo purposes, each created with createTask and assigned to the 'ingredients' section.

methods.name: getRequestedSampleIngredients
methods.description: Returns an array of tasks representing specific sample ingredients, each created with createTask and assigned to the 'ingredients' section.
